decoderRecovery.name: Adapt software decoder recovery (upstream PR #1075)
decoderRecovery.startingPoint: Implemented on e98388a6 after merging the first batch; no remaining implementation for the selected backports.
decoderRecovery.reasonToAdapt: Upstream split its decoder and changed the timeline model. Ours retains a legacy streaming path and decodeClipTimeline/startClipDecodeSession for exact ordered/repeated source ranges. Do not transplant upstream's wrapper/decoder wholesale.
requirements: Retry eligible decoder EncodingError/QuotaExceededError once using software, excluding AV1 which already prefers software.
Replay rebuilds decode state but skips already-successful output callbacks; preserve output timestamps, active clip, source/cursor times and sourceEndMs.
Do not retry cancellation, configuration errors, renderer/encoder callback failures or arbitrary exceptions.
Close held/queued/in-flight frames and decoder before awaiting feed/flush; cancel readers and wake backpressure/dequeue waiters.
Preserve both failure contexts if the software decoder also fails; last submitted chunk is approximate evidence, not proof of corruption.
Keep reporting service, account UI, upstream project/timeline normalization and broad decoder refactor out of this PR.
verification: TDD both existing decoder paths: partial-output recovery/no duplication, cleanup, backward/repeated clips, cancellation and no-retry cases, failed software attempt.
Full unit suite, TypeScript and targeted lint/format.
Real Electron MP4 smoke including injected eligible decoder failure, plus normal 4K WebGL/WebGPU/legacy MP4/GIF timeline smoke.
Keep prior raw-frame ownership, narration, tail-duration and native-export eligibility regressions passing.

lessons: The legacy source-clock regression uses embedded source audio; clip-sequence regressions separately verify independently placed narration. Do not reinterpret legacy source coordinates as edited narration positions when constructing fixtures.
A decoder can fail before any output and software can produce no frames without raising a codec error. Treat empty output for a nonempty job as a failed recovery.
Opening a different project replaces the preview video element. Reuse a source for a persistent element; destroy the source when the element is replaced.
